model_gap_updates.note: Do not infer actual line membership from region/style or substitute narabi forecasts as truth. Human narabi may only be a separately labeled external benchmark.

Official KEIRIN.JP defines H, B, S and historical 逃/捲/差/マ. S0 uses none of them. Existing retrospective parser contains S/B and kimarite summaries but omits H; this is a source/schema gap, not a command to add H to the model.
model_gap_updates.leakage_warning: Counts/summaries must come from a snapshot available before the target race and must not be recomputed using target/later results.

model_gap_updates.note: Current KEIRIN.JP venue analysis exposes circumference, estimated straight length, center/straight slope and track widths. Use only after numeric current-source extraction and effective-date/versioning are made reproducible.

Current JKA judging operations formally measure wind direction, wind speed and temperature. This strengthens mechanism/source plausibility but does not establish that the measurements are publicly available before each prediction timestamp.
Do not change beta or reconstruct the public score from regulatory formulas until cutoff/update semantics are explicitly sourced.
Current lists prove equipment categories/manufacturers are formal realities. Historical rider-level identity and change timestamp remain unresolved, so no equipment feature admission.
DMM worked example is secondary confirmation for ChariLoto only; primary law/regulation remains authoritative. No payout/settlement information enters sporting utility.
